run_create_core_manifest: run the CLI tool to generate denoising, translation, hifigan, and fairseq manifests from km and tsv files
run_verify_dict_size: run verify_dict_size to check if a km file vocabulary size matches a fairseq dict file
run_verify_files_exist: run verify_files_exist to check if a list of Path objects all exist on disk
run_run_cmd: run run_cmd to execute a shell command via subprocess and capture its output
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional km files or custom output directory naming
